title: Invoices
subtitle: VAT-correct invoices for UK, EU and GCC customers, created straight from delivered jobs.

empty.title: No invoices here yet
empty.description: Create your first invoice from delivered jobs — VAT and numbering are handled for you.

form.noUninvoicedJobs: This customer has no delivered jobs waiting to be invoiced.
form.vatNote: Legal note printed on the invoice
form.overridden: You changed the suggested VAT treatment.
form.guidance: VAT suggestions are guidance based on the customer's country, VAT number and route. Check with your accountant for unusual cases.
form.creditReasonHint: Shown on the credit note and sent to ZATCA. It corrects invoice {number}.

rules.domestic: Domestic supply — your standard VAT rate applies.
rules.uk_zero_rated_international: UK business customer and the goods move to or from outside the UK — international transport is zero-rated.
rules.eu_export_exempt: Transport linked to export/import outside the EU — usually exempt. Check your national rules.
rules.uk_outside_scope: Business customer outside the UK — the supply is outside the scope of UK VAT; the customer accounts for VAT.
rules.eu_reverse_charge: Business customer in another EU country with a verified VAT number — reverse charge applies.
rules.eu_reverse_charge_unverified: Reverse charge applies, but the customer's VAT number has not been verified in VIES yet. Verify it before issuing.
rules.eu_outside_eu: Business customer outside the EU — not subject to EU VAT.
rules.b2c_seller_rate: Private customer — your standard VAT rate applies.
rules.b2c_eu_departure: Private customer, intra-EU transport — VAT of the departure country applies; you may need a VAT registration there.
rules.other_seller: No built-in rules for your country — standard rate pre-filled.
rules.gcc_domestic: Transport within your country — your standard VAT rate applies.
rules.gcc_international_zero: The goods move into or out of your country — international transport is zero-rated.
rules.gcc_no_vat: VAT is not in force in your country — no VAT is charged.

errors.invalid: Please check the form — some values are not valid.
errors.invalidLines: The invoice lines could not be read.
errors.noLines: Add at least one line with a description.
errors.dueBeforeIssue: The due date can't be before the issue date.
errors.immutable: This invoice has been issued and can no longer be edited. Void it and create a new one instead.
errors.numbering: Could not allocate an invoice number.
errors.zatcaCurrency: Saudi e-invoices must be in SAR. Change the currency to SAR.
errors.zatcaNegative: Saudi e-invoices cannot have negative lines. Issue a credit note instead of a discount line.

detail.voidConfirm: Void this invoice? Its number is kept and the jobs become available for invoicing again.
detail.immutableNote: Issued invoices are locked to protect your records. Void and re-issue to make changes.
detail.draftNote: This is a draft. Edit it freely, then issue it when ready.
detail.dueIn: {days, plural, =0 {Due today} one {Due in # day} other {Due in # days}}
detail.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
detail.emailHint: Download the PDF and attach it to the email that opens.
detail.creditNoteHelp: A credit note cancels or corrects an issued invoice. You can adjust the lines before issuing it. A credit note for the full amount marks the original invoice as void.
detail.immutableNoteCredit: Issued documents are locked to protect your records. To correct one, issue a credit note.
detail.whatsappText: Hello, here is invoice {number} from {company} for {total}, due on {due}:
detail.whatsappCredit: Hello, here is credit note {number} from {company} for {total}:
detail.emailBodyCredit:
Hello,

Please find attached credit note {number} for {total}, which corrects invoice {original}.

Kind regards,
{company}

zatca.title: Saudi e-invoicing (ZATCA)

state.failed: Waiting — ZATCA could not be reached

zatca.rejectedHelp: Fix the problems above (usually the customer's details), edit the invoice if needed, then submit it again.
zatca.phase1Note: Your company is not connected to ZATCA yet, so this invoice carries the basic (phase 1) QR code only. Connect under Settings → E-invoicing.

buyerField.name: customer
buyerField.vat_number: VAT number (15 digits, starts and ends with 3)
buyerField.id_value: VAT number or another ID (e.g. CR number)

result.cleared: Invoice cleared by ZATCA and issued.
result.reported: Invoice issued and reported to ZATCA.
result.warning: Invoice accepted by ZATCA with warnings — see the details.
result.pending: Invoice issued. ZATCA could not be reached; it will be reported automatically.
result.not_onboarded: Connect your company to ZATCA first (Settings → E-invoicing).
result.currency: Saudi e-invoices must be in SAR.
result.buyer_incomplete: The customer's details are incomplete for a Saudi tax invoice.
result.negative_line: Saudi e-invoices cannot have negative lines. Use a credit note.
result.busy: Another invoice is being signed right now. Please try again in a moment.
result.rejected: ZATCA rejected the invoice. It is still a draft — see the reasons.
result.failed: ZATCA could not be reached. Please try again.
result.already: This invoice has already been sent to ZATCA.
